about.title: About RMP Designer
about.intro: A RMP master node designer, enabling the addition of any SVG to RMP.

svgs.title: SVG Components

complexMode.title: Complex SVG is in read-only mode
complexMode.summary: This SVG contains {{count}} elements, above the {{limit}} element limit for per-node editing.
complexMode.detail: Canvas preview and export still keep the full SVG. To avoid slow editing, the component tree and single-node dragging are disabled; simplify the SVG or split it into smaller SVGs before importing if you need to edit it.

attrPanel.emptyMore: No extra attributes. Unclassified attributes from uploaded SVGs will appear here.

x.title: X position
x.description: Controls the horizontal position of the shape's top-left corner or text start point.
x.effectHint: Larger numbers move it to the right.

y.title: Y position
y.description: Controls the vertical position of the shape's top-left corner or text start point.

x1.title: Start X
x1.description: Controls the horizontal position of a line's start point.
x1.effectHint: Larger numbers move the start point to the right.

y1.title: Start Y
y1.description: Controls the vertical position of a line's start point.
y1.effectHint: Larger numbers move the start point downward.

x2.title: End X
x2.description: Controls the horizontal position of a line's end point.
x2.effectHint: Larger numbers move the end point to the right.

y2.title: End Y
y2.description: Controls the vertical position of a line's end point.
y2.effectHint: Larger numbers move the end point downward.

cx.title: Center X
cx.description: Controls the horizontal position of a circle or ellipse center.
cx.effectHint: Larger numbers move the center to the right.

cy.title: Center Y
cy.description: Controls the vertical position of a circle or ellipse center.
cy.effectHint: Larger numbers move the center downward.

dx.title: Horizontal offset
dx.description: Moves text or child elements left or right from their original position.
dx.effectHint: Positive values move right; negative values move left.

dy.title: Vertical offset
dy.description: Moves text or child elements up or down from their original position.
dy.effectHint: Positive values move down; negative values move up.

width.title: Width
width.description: Controls how much horizontal space the shape takes.

height.title: Height
height.description: Controls how much vertical space the shape takes.

r.title: Radius
r.description: Controls the distance from a circle center to its edge.
r.effectHint: Larger numbers make the circle larger.

rx.title: Horizontal radius / corner
rx.description: Controls a rectangle's horizontal corner radius or an ellipse's horizontal radius.
rx.effectHint: For rectangles, larger numbers make left and right corners rounder.

ry.title: Vertical radius / corner
ry.description: Controls a rectangle's vertical corner radius or an ellipse's vertical radius.
ry.effectHint: For rectangles, larger numbers make top and bottom corners rounder.

d.title: Path
d.description: Controls the outline of a path shape.
d.effectHint: Usually kept from imported SVG software; hand editing is not recommended.

points.title: Point list
points.description: Controls the points used by a polyline or polygon.
points.effectHint: Each pair of numbers is a point, for example 0,0 20,0.

fill.title: Fill color
fill.description: Controls the color inside the shape.
fill.effectHint: Set it to none to make the fill transparent.

color.title: Color
color.description: Sets a base color inherited by child elements or text.

stroke.title: Stroke color
stroke.description: Controls the color of the outline or line.
stroke.effectHint: Set it to none to hide the outline.

stroke-width.title: Stroke width
stroke-width.description: Controls how thick the outline is.
stroke-width.effectHint: Larger numbers make the outline thicker. 0 means no outline.

stroke-dasharray.title: Dash pattern
stroke-dasharray.description: Controls whether the outline or line is dashed.
stroke-dasharray.effectHint: For example, 4 2 means a line segment followed by a gap.

stroke-linecap.title: Line cap
stroke-linecap.description: Controls whether line ends are flat, round, or square.
stroke-linecap.effectHint: round usually works better for rail maps.

stroke-linejoin.title: Line join
stroke-linejoin.description: Controls the shape of line corners.

_rmp_children_text.title: Text content
_rmp_children_text.description: Controls the text shown by this text element.

font-size.title: Font size
font-size.effectHint: Larger numbers make the text larger.

font-family.title: Font family
font-family.description: Controls the font family used by text.
font-family.effectHint: Usually prefer text style classes instead of direct font names.

letter-spacing.title: Letter spacing
letter-spacing.effectHint: Negative values tighten text; positive values spread it out.

text-anchor.title: Horizontal alignment
text-anchor.description: Controls how text aligns around its X position.
text-anchor.effectHint: middle centers the text on the X position.

dominant-baseline.title: Vertical alignment
dominant-baseline.description: Controls how text aligns around its Y position.
dominant-baseline.effectHint: middle/central is often used to place text in the center of a shape.

className.title: Text style
className.description: Selects a built-in RMP text style.
className.effectHint: Use it to match fonts for different cities or languages.

transform.title: Move / rotate / scale
transform.description: Applies an overall transform to the shape.
transform.effectHint: For example, translate(10, 0) moves the whole shape right.

viewBox.title: View box
viewBox.description: Controls the visible coordinate range inside an SVG.
viewBox.effectHint: Usually used for full SVG containers; avoid changing it casually.

opacity.title: Opacity
opacity.description: Controls whether the whole shape is transparent.
opacity.effectHint: 0 is fully transparent; 1 is fully opaque.

clip-path.title: Clip area
clip-path.description: Uses another shape to cut away part of the current shape.
clip-path.effectHint: Usually comes from imported SVGs and can be left unchanged.

mask.title: Mask
mask.description: Uses a mask to control which parts of the shape are visible.
mask.effectHint: Usually comes from imported SVGs and can be left unchanged.

filter.title: Filter
filter.description: Adds SVG effects such as shadow or blur.
filter.effectHint: RMP compatibility depends on the exact filter content.

style.title: Style sheet
style.description: Keeps inline styles from imported SVGs.
style.effectHint: Usually comes from uploaded SVGs; edit only when fine tuning is needed.

svgs.tipsB2: and then click the canvas to add a SVG component.

smoothPath.title: Smooth path
smoothPath.widthStopsHint: Position is a percentage along the path.

multiLangEntry.name: Name
multiLangEntry.add: Add a name in another language
